desc:
Long ago in the far land of Eryndor, tales were often shaped by myths and legends. Become royalty who seeks to serve or control, or choose to adventure with your small band of misfits to battle great foes. 
Here, your story has yet to be written.

👍 2000 Likes reached!
MILDARUHL progress will start soon . . .

— ❗ This game has just released! ❗ 
     ⚬  Some parts of the game is unfinished. 
     ⚬  Expect bugs and more content to be added over time. (Tools, Locations, Collectibles, etc)
— ⚠️ This is a freeform roleplay; there's no established factions, characters, or even lore that you have to abide by.
— 🏠 Most interiors are teleport only. Use 'Zonevision' to see where players are gathered. 
— ⏳ Mythage has a very large map with over 50 locations and five dimensions. Expect some degree of lag.
— 🎲 Inspired by Skyrim, Lord of the Rings, Baldur's Gate 3 and Dungeons & Dragons.

⭐Join the group for in-game benefits, such as the Backpack and Rides library!⭐
